title: Iowa Sales Tax: Rates, Rules & Compliance Guide
summary: Complete guide to Iowa sales tax: 6% state rate, up to 1% local option, digital product taxability, nexus rules, registration, and filing deadlines.
body_markdown:
**Iowa Sales Tax Quick Facts**


**Iowa sales tax rate:**


6% (7% in most localities)


**Max combined state sales tax rate:**


7%


**Economic nexus threshold:**


$100,000 or more in gross sales in the current or immediately preceding calendar year


**What sales count toward the threshold:**


Gross sales, including marketplace sales


**Tax authority:**


[Iowa Department of Revenue](https://revenue.iowa.gov/)


**Tax portal:**


[GovConnectIowa](https://revenue.iowa.gov/resources/govconnectiowa-help)


**SaaS taxable:**


B2C SaaS is taxable, B2B SaaS is nontaxable


**Administration difficulty:**


2/5
